about.title: Why Medellín.
about.lead: The setting is not a detail of the program. It is part of why it works.
about.body:
Medellín holds a climate the body finds naturally restorative all year long, the reason it is known as the City of Eternal Spring. There is no winter to interrupt a three-month cycle, and no summer to make it unsustainable.

Around that climate grew one of the strongest care networks in Latin America: certified professionals, trained in and outside the country, to standards the city has been exporting for decades. That network is why thousands of people travel to Medellín every year to look after themselves, and why premium care here does not cost what it costs in North America.

Whether you live in the city or come in from elsewhere, we work the same way: we match you to the right program, coordinate whatever needs coordinating, and stay with you through the cycle.
about.visitTitle: How it works from a distance.
about.visitBody: You can begin your initial assessment remotely, before buying a ticket. If the program makes sense for you, we coordinate your dates and get everything ready so your time in Medellín is the program, not the logistics.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.body:
RegenerAxis ("we", "us") respects your privacy and protects the personal data you share with us. This policy explains what we collect, why, and the rights you have over your information.

Information we collect

We collect only the data you provide voluntarily through our contact and booking forms and through WhatsApp: your name, country or city, program of interest, and the contents of your message. When you book a paid assessment, scheduling and payment are handled by our booking and payment providers, who process your data under their own terms.

How we use it

We use your data to respond to your enquiries, complete an eligibility check, coordinate your initial assessment, and provide the service you request. We do not sell your personal data, and we do not share it with third parties for advertising.

Service providers

We rely on trusted providers for scheduling, payment processing, hosting, and basic, privacy-respecting traffic analytics. These providers only receive the data needed to perform their function.

Data retention

We keep your data only as long as needed to attend to your request and to meet our legal and accounting obligations, after which it is deleted or anonymized.

Your rights

Under Colombian data-protection law (Ley 1581 de 2012, Habeas Data), you may request access to, correction, updating, or deletion of your personal data, and you may withdraw consent at any time. To exercise these rights, contact us through the contact page or via WhatsApp.
